verdict.rationale: Gemini publishes a public pricing page with self-serve, pay-as-you-go pricing and no mention of contacting sales. A community post quotes concrete per-million-token rates for Gemini 3 Pro, and the Batch API is documented as costing 50% of standard prices. However, the pack contains no first-party per-token price figures, and nothing shows that every current model is listed. Missing for 10: first-party per-token rates quoted from the pricing page, evidence of coverage across every current model (e.g. Gemini 4 family, Imagen, Veo, embeddings).

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every current model without talking to sales

citations.quote: Cömert sınırlamalarla ücretsiz olarak geliştirmeye başlayın, ardından üretime hazır uygulamalarınız için ön ödemeli ve kullandıkça öde fiyatlandırmasıyla ölçeğinizi artırın.
API pricing is up to $2/M for input and $12/M for output.
The Gemini Batch API is designed to process large volumes of requests asynchronously at 50% of the standard cost.
